Thanks again for speaking with our team yesterday. As discussed, attached is the short coding task intended to give you a chance to show how you approach systems design + implementation for a focused routing problem. High-level details: 

- Estimated effort: 3–5 hours (we're flexible if your schedule requires a little more time)
- Deliverables: a README describing approach, a small service implementation (or runnable script), and any test cases you used
- Deadline: submit by 11:59pm PT on Thursday, May 20 (we can extend if you need it; reply with an ETA)

Attached: coding_task_prompt.pdf (prompt + input/output format), evaluation_rubric.xlsx (what reviewers will check). Please upload your submission to a single zip file and reply to this thread with a link (Drive/Dropbox/GitHub) or attach it directly to the email. If you prefer to share a private repo, include repo access for jasmine/ marissa/mina.

Review process: Marissa and Mina will each perform an independent read and score using the rubric; Karthik will do a quick sanity pass on architecture notes. We'll aim to consolidate feedback and get back to you within two business days after you submit.

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm you received the prompt
2) Let us know if the deadline works or if you'd like an extension

Thanks — looking forward to seeing your approach.
